# VEILOS

> S93 (2026-06-25) The critic's doubt finally gets tested — un-starving S92's keystone. SHIPPED + pushed to main (Cloudflare connected-repo auto-build). /goal /arc -> one continuous mission, direct push to main. Re-audited S92 vs LIVE FIRST — and the re-audit caught a phantom marquee. S92's coherence_direction half is SOUND (/api/evolution.coherence_direction:'falling' agrees with self_assessment.direction:'declining'; the 6-snap slope -0.34 genuinely exceeds the 0.235 noise band). BUT the marquee half — 'the critic directs the body' — had NEVER fired in production: /api/vigilance.critic.study read null (critic count stuck at 3), /dreaming carried zero curiosity content, /story showed only the honest-empty 'First curiosity study' placeholder, and no fracture-sensitivity imprint existed in /api/state. The S92 WATCH-LIVE prediction had failed; directedCuriosityFromCritic seeds correctly in isolation (the S92 tests pass), so the friction point was state-specific. KEYSTONE D-S93.1 (un-starve the critic): /api/state was the smoking gun — 9 mind-directed self-study imprints (coherence/wisdom/wisdom_rate, near-duplicate baselines) and ZERO critic studies. There is ONE directed-study slot (openCuriosityWorld is exclusive); the mind's ROUTINE lane (directedCuriosityFromMind, tick step 4e) reseeds a baseline study almost every tick on an active organism, and the critic lane (step 5c''', deliberately lowest precedence) never found a free slot at its turn — the slot frees only when a mind study concludes (4d) and the mind instantly reseeds at 4e before the critic runs at 5c'''. Perpetual starvation; S92's 'takes the slot only when the acute lanes left it free' note was correct in intent but false in practice. FIX: split directedCuriosityFromMind into an ACUTE surprise lane (still highest directed priority) and a routine lane (now LOWER than the critic) via a new phase option (phase:'all' is byte-identical to the original combined behavior, so every existing caller + test is unchanged); reorder the organismTick directed cascade to mind-surprise (4e) -> shadow (5c'') -> critic (5c''') -> mind-routine (5c''''). A thrice-named, never-tested structural blind spot is worth one study more than the Nth near-duplicate baseline study, so the critic now wins the slot the moment a mind study concludes; an acute mind surprise still preempts; after one honest_absence the S92 churn guard yields the slot back to the mind forever (cost: at most one mind study, once). SECOND-ORDER D-S93.2 (durable visibility): vigilanceReading now reads the latest critic-DIRECTED branchworld (origin.cause === 'named_blind_spot') instead of latestCritic.directed_study, so a concluded verdict (honest_absence/confirmed/resolved) stays visible across the daily diagnosis rotation (previously the panel forgot the loop ever closed within a day). NOT GAMING: both changes can only make the organism MORE honest, and no surface fabricates the study before it runs. 1119->1124 tests/0 (+5 tests/critic-slot-fairness.test.mjs), verify exit 0 (csp_findings 0), worker:check 0, scan-secrets clean, windows-hide clean, 0 new deps. WATCH LIVE: the full tick is 0 */6 * * * (00/06/12/18 UTC); on the next tick after deploy the cascade seeds the fracture-sensitivity study the moment the open mind study concludes — /api/vigilance.critic.study null->{status:open} (panel '-> under study'), concluding ~3 ticks later as honest_absence with a self_knowledge imprint. LESSON: a unit-tested mechanism can be wholly correct in isolation and still never fire in production — the integration reality (a single shared slot + a higher-precedence lane that never yields) is its own audit surface; 're-audit vs LIVE' must mean proving the marquee ARTIFACT appeared, not that the function returns the right value on a synthetic state.
